comps.label: C1

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Civil site development and paving contractor serving developers and municipalities, not oilfield equipment or services.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Mainly laboratory reservoir analysis and consulting, with a narrow perforating business, so it is less of a full-service well-construction and production provider.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Rents and sells downhole drilling tools and provides directional drilling and wellbore services to operators, matching Weatherford's drilling tools and rental model.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Permian midstream operator earning fees on gas gathering and processing pipelines, not oilfield equipment or well services.
